title2: On the corridor that connects Mexico with North America.
description1: True Ciénega Industrial Park fronts the Monterrey–Nuevo Laredo Highway (Highway 85), the main overland freight route between Mexico and the United States, with immediate highway access and quick connections to the Colombia Highway and Monterrey’s Periférico ring road.
description2: From here, your operation connects to Monterrey International Airport, the Interpuerto, the Colombia Bridge, and the Laredo border crossing — the busiest commercial gateway between Mexico and the United States.
description3: And there's an advantage few locations offer: every route north — Interpuerto, Colombia, Laredo — starts on the same highway that fronts the park. Your trailers don't cross the city; they head straight to the corridor.
